A1.justification: Both 43-page PDFs describe the same SurpMark research and include complete Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 3–43 are identical; the differences on pages 1–2 are fully readable.

before.justification: v2 reports original detection experiments in Section 4 and Appendices B and E, including AUROC comparisons, ablations, and robustness evaluations.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparisons and all appendix evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 2 and Appendix A retain the same proxy-surprisal quantization, first-order transition estimation, two-reference GJS score, and threshold decision procedure.

E1.justification: Dataset and scenario coverage is identical, including XSum, WritingPrompts, SQuAD, WMT19, HC3, DetectRL, DAIGT, and Dolly, with the same multilingual, mixed-source, and distribution-shift evaluations.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain the same 13 baselines. Comparator membership also remains unchanged in the corresponding robustness, ablation, and appendix comparisons.

E3.justification: Reference/test sampling, preprocessing, proxy models, decoding settings, and evaluation metrics are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendix E. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The same analyses examine quantization, Markov order, reference size, text length, proxy choice, thresholds, adversarial perturbations, and pretraining exposure. Their supporting tables and figures are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix E.2.1 retains averaging over three randomly sampled test sets. Standard-deviation reporting, error bars, variance comparisons, and Shapiro–Wilk tests are also unchanged.

E6.justification: All reported numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged across the main text and appendices. For example, Tables 2 and 3 retain SurpMark k=6 average AUROCs of 91.23 and 77.72, respectively.

T1.justification: Section 3 and Appendices B and D retain identical mathematical definitions, Markov assumptions, discretization-estimation bounds, likelihood-ratio analysis, and proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same method, theoretical, and empirical claims. The repository link adds no scientific claim.

C2.justification: Interpretations of transition dynamics, sparsity, robustness, and pretraining exposure are unchanged. The Markov-approximation qualifications, limitations, and impact statement are also retained verbatim.

D1.justification: v3 adds a clickable SurpMark GitHub repository link beneath the abstract, absent from v2. This adds implementation-access information; Appendix E.1 remains unchanged. The PDFs do not establish the repository's contents or completeness.

R1.justification: Section 1.2, Appendix C, and the reference list retain the same cited works and research positioning.

P1.justification: Front matter gains the repository-address line and an updated arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific wording, terminology, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The repository icon and link slightly reflow the introduction across columns and pages 1–2. Figures, tables, and captions are unchanged; rendered pages 3–43 are identical.

improvement.justification: The prominent repository link in v3 provides an implementation-access pointer missing from v2, modestly improving resource discoverability. Scientific content and evidence, including all appendices, remain unchanged. The benefit is limited to access information because the supplied PDFs cannot verify the linked implementation.
